name: Baron AI - Lead Finder + Visibility Audit (Combined)

parameters.content:
# 🟢 READ ME FIRST — Lead Finder + Visibility Audit (combined)

**Top half (this section):** finds local businesses, checks their websites, scores them 0–100, drafts an honest outreach pack, saves everything to Google Sheets for MANUAL review. Nothing is ever sent to a prospect automatically.

**Bottom half (scroll down):** your existing AI Visibility Audit — unchanged. It now starts from EITHER its form (default: you pick a lead from the sheet and submit it) OR automatically for the top Hot Lead when AUTO_AUDIT_HOT_LEADS is switched on.

## Setup checklist:
**1. Credentials** (Settings → Credentials):
- `Google Places API Key` → Header Auth → Name: `X-Goog-Api-Key` (enable *Places API (New)* in Google Cloud)
- `Anthropic API Key` → Header Auth → Name: `x-api-key`
- `Perplexity API Key` → Header Auth → Name: `Authorization`, Value `Bearer pplx-...` (audit)
- `OpenAI API Key` → Header Auth → Name: `Authorization`, Value `Bearer sk-...` (audit)
- `Google Sheets account` → OAuth2
- `Gmail account` → OAuth2
- `Telegram Bot` → optional (run summary)

**2. Create the leads Google Sheet** — headers in the Sheet sticky note (right). Paste its ID + URL into `EDIT THIS SECTION FIRST`.

**3. Re-select credentials** in every node showing a red ⚠ after import.

**4. Edit `EDIT THIS SECTION FIRST`** — location, business type, modes, your company details.

**5. Keep TESTING_MODE: true** for first runs (3 leads, TEST rows, dummy data if APIs missing, auto-audit blocked).

▶ Run: click *Execute workflow* on the Manual Trigger. Weekly Schedule Trigger ships DISABLED.

## ▶ TRIGGERS

**Manual Trigger** — click *Execute workflow* any time you want a batch of leads.

**Schedule Trigger** — weekly (Monday 08:00). It is **disabled** by default so nothing runs behind your back. Right-click the node → *Enable* to switch it on. The workflow itself must also be Active (top-right toggle) for schedules to fire.

Tip: run manually per business type first (change `business_category` in the config, run, change, run) — one category per run gives the cleanest lead lists.

## 🟡 EDIT THIS SECTION FIRST

**This is where you change the business type or location — usually the only node you touch.**

- `target_location` / `target_country` — default Birmingham, United Kingdom
- `business_category` — default electricians (or dentists, beauty salons, car garages, estate agents, accountants, private clinics, restaurants...)
- `max_leads`, `min_rating`, `min_reviews`, `must_have_website`
- `google_sheet_id` + `google_sheet_url` + `sheet_name` — your CRM (Google Sheets)

**THE THREE MODES:**
- `TESTING_MODE: true` → 3 leads only, TEST rows, dummy data if APIs missing, no auto-audit. Set false to go LIVE.
- `REVIEW_MODE: true` (default) → find → score → draft outreach → save → WAIT for your manual review. This is the safe default.
- `AUTO_AUDIT_HOT_LEADS: false` (default) → set true and each LIVE run also pushes its TOP Hot Lead through the full Visibility Audit automatically (one per run, to control cost). Report goes to `notify_email`.

- Company details + `outreach_tone` — used in the drafted messages
- `notify_email` + `telegram_chat_id` — run summary destinations

## 🔎 LEAD SOURCES

**Default: Google Places API (New) Text Search.** Credential: Header Auth `X-Goog-Api-Key`. Enable *Places API (New)* in Google Cloud (generous free monthly credit covers thousands of searches). Returns name, category, website, phone, address, rating, review count, Maps URL. **Emails are NOT provided by Google** — the Website Checker extracts any email it finds on the site instead.

**Alternative sources (disabled placeholders below):**
- **SerpAPI** — HTTP GET `https://serpapi.com/search?engine=google_maps&q=...&api_key=...`
- **Apify / Outscraper** — run their Google Maps scraper actors, fetch results via HTTP; higher volume, paid
- **Manual CSV** — replace the Places node with a *Read/Write Files* or *Extract From File* node; map columns to: business_name, category, website_url, phone, address, rating, reviews

Whichever source you use, feed it into `Prepare & Normalise Leads` in the same field format and everything downstream just works.

## 🌐 WEBSITE CHECKER + SCORING (out of 100)

Each lead's site is checked for: loads OK, contact page, service pages, target city mentioned, FAQ/pricing content, schema markup, blog/content, third-party directory badges (Checkatrade, Trustpilot, Yell, Rated People, TrustATrader, Which?, Facebook/Instagram), plus an email harvest.

**Scoring:**
- Has website **+20**
- Website loads **+10**
- Service pages found **+10**
- Location/city mentioned **+10**
- FAQ/pricing content **+10**
- Schema markup **+10**
- Strong reviews (≥ your minimums) **+15**
- Third-party directory presence **+15**
- SEO/Ads/marketing signals **+20**
(capped at 100)

## 💰 MARKETING SIGNALS = HIGH INTENT
Also detected: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Yoast/RankMath, WordPress, UTM links, landing pages, agency footer credits, call tracking.

**Any found → the business already spends money online → HIGH INTENT.** Your best prospects: they understand marketing, have budget, and are used to paying monthly.

## 🧠 AI LEAD ANALYST + ✍️ OUTREACH GENERATOR

Claude reviews each lead and returns: summary, **main weakness**, suggested service, priority + reason — AND, for Hot/Warm leads only, a full outreach pack:
- Cold email (max 120 words)
- LinkedIn message
- Phone call script
- Follow-up after 3 days
- Follow-up after 7 days

All saved to the sheet as **DRAFTS for manual review — never sent automatically.**

**Honesty rules baked into the prompt** — the AI is forbidden from writing: 'guaranteed #1 in ChatGPT', 'AI will always recommend you', 'we control ChatGPT', 'secret ranking trick'. It uses honest framings instead: improve AI visibility, track before/after mentions, strengthen the signals AI tools rely on, make your website easier for AI to understand, show monthly evidence.

**Classification:** Hot (website + strong reviews + marketing spend + clear weaknesses), Warm (website + decent presence + some weaknesses), Low Priority (weak presence), Not Suitable (no website / bad data / irrelevant).

🖊 Edit the prompt inside `AI Lead Analyst` to change judging or writing style. AI errors never break the run — the lead saves as Low Priority with a note.

## 📊 SHEET (CRM) + DUPLICATES + ERRORS

**Create a Google Sheet with these exact headers (row 1):**
`Date Found | Business Name | Business Type | Location | Website URL | Phone Number | Email | Address | Google Rating | Number of Reviews | Website Status | Contact Page Found | Service Page Found | SEO Signals Found | Marketing Signals Found | Lead Quality Score | Lead Priority | Main Weakness | Suggested Service | Suggested Outreach Message | LinkedIn Message | Phone Script | Follow Up Day 3 | Follow Up Day 7 | Source | Status | Notes`

Default **Status = "Not Contacted"** (TEST in testing mode, ERROR for problem rows).

**Duplicate check:** existing rows are read first; any lead whose *Business Name + Website URL* already exists is **skipped** (count in the summary). To *update* instead: change the Save node to **Append or Update** matching on Business Name.

**Errors never stop a run** — API/website/AI/Sheets problems go into the Notes column or the summary. 'No leads found' writes one ERROR row.

**Excel/OneDrive instead:** swap the two Google Sheets nodes for Microsoft Excel 365 nodes, same field names.

## 📬 RUN SUMMARY + 🧪 TESTING MODE

After every run you get a summary by **Email (Gmail)** and **Telegram** (both optional — if a credential is missing the run still completes):
- Leads found / saved / skipped as duplicates
- Hot and Warm lead counts
- Top 5 leads by score
- Link to the sheet

Destinations are set in `EDIT THIS SECTION FIRST` (notify_email, telegram_chat_id — message @userinfobot on Telegram to get yours).

**TESTING MODE (config flag):**
- ON → only 3 leads processed, rows marked TEST, dummy sample businesses used if the Places API isn't connected yet, summary prefixed [TEST]
- OFF → full live run

**Safe first test:** TESTING_MODE true → Execute workflow → check 3 TEST rows appear in your sheet and the summary arrives → then connect the real Places key → run again → only then set TESTING_MODE false.

Write in UK English. Prices in GBP. Tone: ' + $('EDIT THIS SECTION FIRST').first().json.config.outreach_tone + '.

- Hot Lead: has a website AND strong reviews AND signs of marketing activity/spend AND clear website weaknesses - likely to pay for a monthly service.
- Warm Lead: has a website and a decent online presence, with some weaknesses found.

- Not Suitable: no website, or bad/missing data, or not relevant to the agency services.

OUTREACH (only if Hot Lead or Warm Lead - otherwise return empty strings): write 5 pieces, each referencing ONE specific observed weakness or opportunity from the data. These are DRAFTS saved for a human to review and send manually - never sent automatically.
1. cold_email: max 120 words, soft question at the end.
2. linkedin_message: max 60 words, casual, no links.
3. phone_script: 4-6 short lines the caller can say naturally, including one question.
4. followup_3d: max 60 words, references the first email lightly, adds one new specific point.
5. followup_7d: max 50 words, polite final nudge, easy opt-out line.

HONESTY RULES - never write anything resembling: guaranteed number 1 in ChatGPT; AI will always recommend you; we control ChatGPT or any AI; secret ranking trick; guaranteed results. Instead use honest framings like: improve your AI visibility; track before/after mentions; strengthen the signals AI tools rely on; make your website easier for AI tools to understand; we show monthly evidence of progress.

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences: {"lead_summary": "2 short sentences", "main_weakness": "the single biggest weakness or opportunity found", "suggested_service": "one specific service to pitch", "lead_priority": "Hot Lead" or "Warm Lead" or "Low Priority" or "Not Suitable", "priority_reason": "one sentence why", "cold_email": "...", "linkedin_message": "...", "phone_script": "...", "followup_3d": "...", "followup_7d": "..."}') }}}] }

## 🌉 LEAD → AUDIT BRIDGE

**Default (manual, recommended):** work the leads sheet, pick a Hot Lead, open the **Audit Request Form** URL (from the form node below) and submit that business. The full 3-engine Visibility Audit runs and the report lands in your inbox — your screenshot-backed sales pitch.

**Optional (automatic):** set `AUTO_AUDIT_HOT_LEADS: true` in the config. Each LIVE run then pushes its single TOP Hot Lead into the audit automatically (one per run to control API cost, ~£1–£2.50 each). Never fires in TESTING_MODE.

The `Audit Input` node makes both entry paths identical, so the audit section below runs completely unchanged.

nodes.name: Auto-Audit Enabled?
nodes.notes: TRUE only when AUTO_AUDIT_HOT_LEADS is true AND testing mode is off. Otherwise the run ends after the summary and you review the sheet manually (default).

nodes.name: Pick Top Hot Lead
nodes.notes: Feeds the run's best Hot Lead into the audit (auto mode only). No changes needed.

parameters.content:
## 🟢 READ ME FIRST — Setup Checklist

Do these 5 things after importing, in order:

**1. Create 4 credentials** (Settings → Credentials):
- `Anthropic API Key` → type **Header Auth** → Name: `x-api-key` → Value: your key from console.anthropic.com
- `Perplexity API Key` → type **Header Auth** → Name: `Authorization` → Value: `Bearer pplx-xxxx` (key from perplexity.ai/settings/api)
- `OpenAI API Key` → type **Header Auth** → Name: `Authorization` → Value: `Bearer sk-xxxx` (key from platform.openai.com)
- `Gmail account` → type **Gmail OAuth2**

**2. Re-select credentials** in these 6 nodes (they show a red ⚠ after import): Ask Claude, Ask Perplexity, Ask ChatGPT, Analyse Mentions, Generate HTML Report, Send Report.

**3. Edit your branding** → open the *Generate HTML Report* node and replace the contact placeholder text in the prompt with Baron AI's real email/phone/website.

**4. Activate the workflow** (toggle top-right).

**5. Get your form link** → open *Audit Request Form* node → copy the Production URL. That link is your audit intake — bookmark it.

💷 Cost per full audit: roughly £1–£2.50 in API fees across all 3 engines.

## 📋 Intake + Prompt Builder

**Audit Request Form** — no changes needed. Fill it per prospect/client. Business Name must match how they appear publicly online (this is what mention-detection looks for).

**Build Prompts** — generates up to 18 questions from the form. Things you can safely edit inside the code:
- The question templates (the 3 lines starting `prompts.push(...)`) — reword to match how real customers in your niche talk.
- `.slice(0, 4)` — max services used (raise = more prompts = higher cost).
- `.slice(0, 18)` — total prompt cap.

⚠️ Keep prompts identical month-to-month for the same client — that's what makes before/after scores comparable.

## 🤖 The 3 AI Engines

Each prompt is asked on **Claude** (with live web search), **Perplexity** (sonar — web-grounded by default), and **ChatGPT** (OpenAI Responses API with web search).

**Credentials:** each node uses its own Header Auth credential — see Read Me note.

**Batching:** requests run 2-at-a-time with a 1.5s gap to avoid rate limits. If you hit 429 errors, raise `batchInterval` to 3000 in the node's Options → Batching.

**Don't have all 3 API keys yet?** You can delete an engine branch (e.g. Ask ChatGPT + Normalise ChatGPT Answer), then open *Merge Answers* and reduce **Number of Inputs** from 3 → 2. The rest still works.

⚠️ Reality check: these APIs are close *proxies* for the consumer apps, not exact copies. For cold outreach, still manually screenshot 2–3 prompts in the real ChatGPT app — the screenshot is your hook, this workflow is the depth behind it.

## 🔍 Analysis + Scoring

**Analyse Mentions** — sends all 3 answers per question to Claude, which returns strict JSON: mentioned yes/no, list position, sentiment, competitors recommended instead, and the single best quote for your sales pitch. No changes needed.

**Aggregate Results** — computes:
- Visibility rate % per engine
- Top 8 competitors AI recommends instead (with counts)
- Question-by-question rows for the report table

✅ Before sending a report to a *paying* client, skim the question-by-question table — mention detection is very good but not perfect (oddly-phrased mentions occasionally slip through).

## 📄 Report + Delivery

**Generate HTML Report** — Claude writes a full client-ready HTML report (scorecard, competitor table, question-by-question results, next steps, disclaimer).

🖊 **EDIT THIS NODE:** in the prompt, replace `Baron AI Solutions LTD contact placeholder` with your real contact details. You can also tweak the colour palette instruction (currently dark navy + white) to match your brand.

**Send Report** — emails the HTML to whatever address was entered in the form. Use YOUR email for prospect audits (you forward it with your pitch); the client's email for monthly retainer reports.

💡 Upgrade later: pipe the HTML through Gotenberg (free, self-hosted) to attach a PDF instead — feels more like a £297 deliverable.

## 🔁 Retainer Version (later)

When clients are paying monthly:
1. Duplicate this workflow
2. Replace the Form Trigger with a **Schedule Trigger** (1st of month, 07:00 Europe/London)
3. Add a **Google Sheets** node reading a Clients sheet (same columns as the form)
4. Change every `$('Audit Input')` reference in the code/HTTP nodes to point at the Sheets data
5. Append each month's scores to a history tab → that history chart is why clients don't cancel.

⚠️ Sales language: never promise guaranteed AI placement. Sell measurement + systematic improvement. The report footer already includes the disclaimer.
